schemes.name: PM-USP – Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
schemes.special_eligibility: Top 20 percentile in Class XII board; excludes professional/technical/medical courses
schemes.description: Merit scholarship for top Class XII scorers pursuing regular UG/PG degrees. Not applicable to engineering, medicine, or management.

schemes.name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies
schemes.special_eligibility: Merit-based; selected from top UG graduates
schemes.description: UGC scholarship for top UG graduates pursuing master's degrees. Covers science (₹7,500/month) and humanities (₹5,000/month) streams.

schemes.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for NER
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be domicile of one of 8 NER states (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) studying outside NER
schemes.description: For students from North-Eastern states pursuing UG studies outside their home region. ₹7,800/month for technical/medical/management; ₹5,400/month for others.

schemes.name: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu, Kashmir and Ladakh
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be domicile of J&K or Ladakh; pursuing studies in professional colleges outside J&K/Ladakh. Currently open for renewal only.
schemes.description: Supports students from J&K and Ladakh to pursue professional/technical education in institutions across India.

schemes.name: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
schemes.provider: Dept. of School Education & Literacy, MoE
schemes.special_eligibility: Must clear the NMMS state-level exam in Class 8; renewed annually on passing each class
schemes.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for Class 9–12 students from economically weaker sections. Selected via NMMS exam conducted by states.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be admitted to one of the notified top institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, NLUs, top medical colleges etc.)
schemes.description: Full tuition fee reimbursement plus maintenance allowance for SC students in India's premier institutions.

schemes.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students – Scholarship
schemes.special_eligibility: Must secure admission in notified top-class institutions
schemes.description: Scholarship component of the NFSHEST scheme for ST students in premier institutions. Covers tuition fees and living expenses.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in College for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provider: Dept. of Social Justice & Empowerment (Backward Classes)
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be enrolled in a notified top-class college; OBC/EBC/DNT category
schemes.description: For OBC, EBC, and DNT students in premier colleges. Covers tuition fees and maintenance up to ₹1.25 lakh per year.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in Schools for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
schemes.provider: Dept. of Social Justice & Empowerment (Backward Classes)
schemes.special_eligibility: Enrolled in notified residential schools for OBC/EBC/DNT students. Currently open for renewal only.
schemes.description: Supports OBC, EBC, and DNT students in Class 9–12 at notified top residential schools across India.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.provider: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.special_eligibility: Minimum 40% disability; studying in Class 9 or 10
schemes.description: For Class 9–10 students with 40%+ disability. Provides maintenance allowance and study grant regardless of income.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.provider: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.special_eligibility: Minimum 40% disability; Class 11 and above
schemes.description: For students with 40%+ disability pursuing Class 11 and above. Covers maintenance, study materials, and reader allowance.

schemes.name: Scholarship for Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
schemes.provider: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.benefit_label: Full tuition + allowances in top institutions
schemes.special_eligibility: 40%+ disability; must be enrolled in a notified top institution
schemes.description: Full fee coverage and allowances for students with disabilities admitted to India's premier institutions.

schemes.name: AICTE – Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
schemes.special_eligibility: Enrolled in first year (or second year via lateral entry) of AICTE-approved technical degree (BE/B.Tech/B.Arch/B.Plan/B.Pharma)
schemes.description: Encourages girls in technical degree education. ₹50,000/year for tuition, books, computer, and other study expenses.

schemes.name: AICTE – Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
schemes.special_eligibility: Enrolled in AICTE-approved technical diploma programme
schemes.description: Same as Pragati Degree but for girls in technical diploma courses. ₹30,000/year for educational expenses.

schemes.name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Student (Technical Degree)
schemes.special_eligibility: 40%+ disability; enrolled in AICTE-approved technical degree programme
schemes.description: For differently-abled students in technical degree programmes. ₹50,000/year towards education costs.

schemes.name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Student (Technical Diploma)
schemes.special_eligibility: 40%+ disability; enrolled in AICTE-approved technical diploma programme
schemes.description: For differently-abled students in technical diploma programmes. ₹30,000/year towards education costs.

schemes.name: AICTE – Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Degree)
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be an orphan, OR ward of armed forces/CAPF personnel killed in action, OR ward of parents who died due to COVID-19 (PM CARES child)
schemes.description: For orphans, wards of armed forces/CAPF martyrs, and COVID-19 orphans in AICTE-approved technical degree programmes.

schemes.name: AICTE – Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Diploma)
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be an orphan, OR ward of armed forces/CAPF personnel killed in action, OR ward of parents who died due to COVID-19 (PM CARES child)
schemes.description: Same as Swanath Degree but for AICTE-approved technical diploma programmes. ₹30,000/year.

schemes.name: Financial Support to the Students of NER for Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be domicile of one of 8 NER states; pursuing professional/technical UG or PG courses. Open for renewal.
schemes.description: Financial support for NER students pursuing professional courses (engineering, medicine, management, law) anywhere in India.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Ministry of Railways
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be ward of Railway Group C employee who died or was permanently disabled in service
schemes.description: For wards of Railway employees (Group C) who died or were disabled on duty. Covers first professional degree (BE, MBBS, BDS, B.Ed, LLB etc.).

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be ward of CAPF or Assam Rifles personnel killed in action or permanently disabled in service
schemes.description: For wards of CAPF/Assam Rifles personnel martyred or disabled in duty. Covers first professional degree programmes.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel Martyred During Terror/Naxal Attacks
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be ward of state/UT police personnel who were martyred in terrorist or Naxal attacks
schemes.description: Scholarship for wards of state/UT police martyrs (terror/Naxal attacks) pursuing their first professional degree.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM – Pre-Matric
schemes.special_eligibility: Parent/guardian must be a registered worker in the Beedi, Cine, Iron Ore Manganese Ore Chrome Ore (IOMC), or Limestone & Dolomite Mines (LSDM) industries
schemes.description: For Class 9–10 children of workers in specified industries. No income limit — eligibility is based on parent's industry registration.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM – Post-Matric
schemes.special_eligibility: Parent/guardian must be a registered worker in Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM industries
schemes.description: For Class 11 and above children of workers in specified industries. Covers studies up to PhD level.

schemes.name: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and Beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
schemes.special_eligibility: SC/OBC or PM CARES child; for competitive exams (UPSC, banking, SSC, JEE, NEET etc.)
schemes.description: Free coaching at empanelled coaching centres for competitive exams. Includes UPSC, banking exams, SSC, engineering (JEE), and medical (NEET) entrances.

schemes.name: Stipend Scheme for Undergraduate and Postgraduate Studies in Indian Statistical Institute-Kolkata
schemes.special_eligibility: Must be enrolled at Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata (ISI Kolkata) only; merit-based
schemes.description: Stipend for students studying at ISI Kolkata only. ₹4,000/month for UG and ₹8,000/month for PG students on merit basis.

schemes.name: ICAR National Talent Scholarship (NTS-UG)
schemes.special_eligibility: Pursuing BSc (Agriculture) or related life sciences UG at ICAR/state agricultural universities; selected via ICAR entrance exam
schemes.description: Merit scholarship for top students in agricultural sciences at ICAR-affiliated institutions. Selected via ICAR's national talent search exam.

schemes.name: ICAR Post Graduate Scholarship (PGS)
schemes.special_eligibility: Enrolled in PG/PhD programme at ICAR-funded agricultural universities/institutes; merit-based selection
schemes.description: Stipend for postgraduate and doctoral students in agricultural sciences at ICAR-funded institutions.

schemes.name: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
schemes.provider: Dept. of Higher & Technical Education, Govt. of Jharkhand
schemes.special_eligibility: Female student enrolled in B.Tech (2nd–4th year) at BIT Sindri only; must have 50% marks in previous year; not availing any other scholarship
schemes.description: Financial assistance for girls pursuing B.Tech at BIT Sindri, Jharkhand. ₹30,000/year for B.Tech and ₹15,000/year for Diploma. Cannot be combined with other scholarships.

schemes.name: Delhi Higher & Technical Education Support Scheme
schemes.special_eligibility: ⚠️ VERIFY DETAILS: Check myscheme.gov.in/schemes/dhtess before demo. Income limit, exact benefit, and institution restrictions need manual confirmation.
schemes.description: Delhi UT scheme supporting students in higher and technical education. Verify full eligibility and benefit details at the official myScheme page before use.
